analytics.name: Analytic 1864
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies a field device entering firmware update mode and receiving a large data transfer on its firmware-capable protocol port from a source not in the approved engineering workstation list, followed by a device reboot, with post-reboot firmware hash not matching the authorized inventory. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect. Suppress activity that fully matches approved maintenance, commissioning, failover, recovery, or tested control procedures.
